## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. SPY in CORRECTION (1W: -0.35% | 1M: +2.19%) and VXX in RECOVERY (1W: +2.60% | 1M: -10.53%) show mixed risk signals alongside HYG ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.11% | 1M: +1.01%), giving two independent confirmations of a balanced, data-dependent market.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Credit and volatility are the drivers: HYG (1W: +0.11% | 1M: +1.01%) ABOVE TREND signals a cautious credit tone while VXX (1W: +2.60% | 1M: -10.53%) RECOVERY indicates a short-term uptick in fear. Commodities are mixed — GLD ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.65% | 1M: +6.42%) vs CPER in CORRECTION (1W: -0.58% | 1M: +9.27%) — so inflation signals remain uneven.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-cautious: UUP showing strength (1W: +0.55% | 1M: +1.45%) ABOVE TREND while TLT in CORRECTION (1W: -0.15% | 1M: +0.30%) and the yield curve ABOVE TREND show a modest tightening bias in conditions.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Cyclicals and materials leading: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.19% | 1M: +9.78%) and XME ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.19% | 1M: +23.17%) while XLK in CORRECTION (1W: -0.36% | 1M: +2.30%) and XLF in CORRECTION (1W: -1.25% | 1M: +0.38%) show tech/financials pulling back; Style mixed / no clear leadership.

**5. US vs Global?**
US tepid: SPY CORRECTION (1W: -0.35% | 1M: +2.19%) while EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.28% | 1M: +9.23%) outperforms and FXI in CORRECTION (1W: -0.13% | 1M: +3.53%) shows EM gains concentrated outside China.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculation intact but selective: IWM ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.13% | 1M: +6.35%), IBIT ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.02% | 1M: +9.11%) and ARKK ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.73% | 1M: +1.92%) signal demand for riskier assets even as the Speculation Index is in CORRECTION (1W: -0.54% | 1M: +1.74%).

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Precious metals leadership: SLV ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.94% | 1M: +40.34%) and GLD ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.65% | 1M: +6.42%) while industrial metals show divergence with CPER in CORRECTION (1W: -0.58% | 1M: +9.27%).

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy constructive: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.19% | 1M: +9.78%) and BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.77% | 1M: +9.71%) while natural gas UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -0.67% | 1M: -14.63%) remains weak.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: IWM ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.13% | 1M: +6.35%) and EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.28% | 1M: +9.23%). MAJOR divergence across core ETFs — SPY CORRECTION (1W: -0.35% | 1M: +2.19%), XLK CORRECTION (1W: -0.36% | 1M: +2.30%), XLF CORRECTION (1W: -1.25% | 1M: +0.38%), TLT CORRECTION (1W: -0.15% | 1M: +0.30%) — supports a Neutral, selective stance.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor cyclicals exposure via XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.19% | 1M: +9.78%) and XME ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.19% | 1M: +23.17%) and reduce exposure to tech risk (XLK CORRECTION (1W: -0.36% | 1M: +2.30%)); bonds neutral (TLT CORRECTION).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.19% | 1M: +9.78%), XME ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.19% | 1M: +23.17%), XAR ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.82% | 1M: +25.78%). BEARISH: XLK CORRECTION (1W: -0.36% | 1M: +2.30%), XLC BELOW TREND (1W: -2.32% | 1M: -0.95%), XLF CORRECTION (1W: -1.25% | 1M: +0.38%).

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: SLV ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.94% | 1M: +40.34%), URA ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.13% | 1M: +28.75%), BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.77% | 1M: +9.71%). BEARISH: UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -0.67% | 1M: -14.63%), CPER CORRECTION (1W: -0.58% | 1M: +9.27%) — watch for re-acceleration.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX ~20 (complacency/vol risk), HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit-health pivot), XLK/XLF ratio ~2.0 (growth vs value leadership).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive.  
Energy, materials and small caps showing relative strength (XLE ABOVE TREND, XME ABOVE TREND, IWM ABOVE TREND).  
Key risk: major divergences across core ETFs (SPY/XLK/XLF/TLT CORRECTIONS) and a short-term uptick in VXX that could flip the regime if sustained.
